story.iWant: to edit or remove Verified KB entries
story.soThat: I can maintain accuracy over time
story.tasks:
- [ ] **Task 1: UI - List & Controls** (AC: #1, #4, #5) - [ ] Build paginated list/grid with question/answer previews and metadata - [ ] Add search bar and filters (date range, creator) - [ ] Provide Edit/Delete actions per row
- [ ] **Task 2: Edit Flow** (AC: #2) - [ ] Edit modal/drawer with validation; regenerate embedding on save - [ ] Update audit fields (updated_at, updated_by); optimistic UI with rollback
- [ ] **Task 3: Delete Flow** (AC: #3) - [ ] Confirmation dialog; implement soft-delete (`deleted_at`) or policy-approved hard delete - [ ] Exclude deleted entries from retrieval and UI lists
- [ ] **Task 4: API & Query Layer** (AC: #1, #4, #5) - [ ] List endpoint with pagination, search (ILIKE), filters (date range, creator) - [ ] Edit endpoint with re-embedding and validation - [ ] Delete endpoint with scope enforcement and audit logging
- [ ] **Task 5: Observability & Audit** (AC: #2, #3) - [ ] Log edits/deletes with user, timestamps, reason codes - [ ] Metrics: edit count, delete count, search latency - [ ] Add change history or revision log
- [ ] **Task 6: Testing** (AC: all) - [ ] Unit tests: list filters/search, edit validation, delete behavior - [ ] Integration tests: edit regenerates embedding; delete hides entry from lookup - [ ] UI tests: search/filter interactions, edit/save flow, delete confirmation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** I am on the Verified KB page **Then** I see a searchable list of entries with question/answer previews, created by/date, and actions (Edit, Delete)
2. **When** I click "Edit" **Then** I can modify question or answer **And** embedding is regenerated on save
3. **When** I click "Delete" **Then** I see confirmation **And** on confirm, entry is removed
4. **I can search entries by keyword**
5. **I can filter by date range or creator**

artifact.reason: List rendering, search/filter UI, edit/delete controls.
Endpoints for list/edit/delete with scoping and audit logging.
Re-embed updated questions; ensure dimension consistency.
Soft-delete column (`deleted_at`) and audit fields used by management flows.

story-context.constraints: - Edits must regenerate embeddings; deletions should prefer soft-delete with exclusion from retrieval paths. - Enforce tenant/group/bot scoping on all list/edit/delete operations; respect RLS. - Search/filter endpoints must be paginated and efficient (indexes on tenant/group/bot, created_at). - Auditability: log who edited/deleted and when; retain history for compliance.
